spec.name: stable_id_idempotency_history

inputs.history: Git commit history for each request path; parse only UTF-8 JSON objects with stable_id and envelope

spec.statistic: Build retry pairs from successive committed versions of the same durable request path. For each pair compare stable_id and canonicalized envelope bytes. Report n_pairs, stable_id reuse rate, material collision count, and the paths/commits of any collision.
spec.criterion: PROMOTED if n_pairs>=20, stable_id reuse=100%, and material collisions=0. REJECTED if any material collision exists or reuse<95%. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

payload.reason: The frozen TEST names durable GitHub relay requests as its dataset; this revision binds the exact public repo, branch, path, history unit, statistic and literal decision rule.

payload.text: Corrigi a especificação de Idempotência de propostas repetidas: agora ela fixa o histórico público de requests duráveis no TCC, a unidade de retry, a comparação byte-a-byte e o critério literal. Revise esta versão; quem escreveu não aprova.
